authority: CBIC & State Tax Departments (GST) / Income Tax Department (PAN)

verified.note: The Income Tax Department's own explanation of how a PAN is formed, which publishes the structure character by character and is exactly the shape this record's PAN format encodes, including that the tenth character is an alphabetic check digit — whose algorithm the department does not publish, which is why PAN is checked structurally rather than arithmetically. No official GSTN or CBIC page publishes the GSTIN check rule at all, so that engine is uncited too.

note.en: Structure only. The trailing letter of a PAN is an alphabetic check character whose rule the Income Tax Department does not publish, so the format is the whole of what can be checked. Serials run from 0001, so the zero serial is denied by name rather than left to a check character nobody publishes.
B2B e-invoicing has applied above INR 5 crore of annual turnover since August 2023. A GSTIN on the bill is what lets the seller's credit flow.
